meta.name: seo-audit
meta.description: Full SEO audit of a site from its real Search Console + GA4 data — indexation health, CTR anomalies, decaying pages, striking-distance keywords, quick wins. Use when asked to "audit my site", "SEO audit", "why is my organic traffic down", or "SEO health check".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入网站真实流量数据,揪出收录与点击问题,列出可执行的优化清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站自然流量下滑,却不知从哪查起。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if organic traffic is slipping and you don't know where to start.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 用你自己的 Search Console 和 GA4 数据做 SEO 审计，产出报告：开头给结论和最大问题，再分索引、流失页、快速见效项等节，每节附表格和具体改法，末尾是 5 条按优先级排的行动清单。
howto.when: 当你说“audit my site”“SEO audit”“为什么自然流量下降”等，或要求做 SEO 健康检查时触发。需要先接入 Ryze MCP 连接器。

say.text: 帮我做一次 SEO 审计，看看站点整体状况
say.note: 会先用你的 GSC/GA4 数据跑完整报告

say.text: 为什么我的自然流量下滑了？
say.note: 会对比近 90 天与上一个 90 天

say.text: 列出排在第 8–20 位、曝光高的关键词
say.note: 这是报告里的「快速见效项」

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits your site from your own Search Console and GA4 data and outputs a report: verdict and top issue first, then indexation, losers, quick wins and cannibalization sections, ending in a 5-item ranked action list.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "audit my site", "SEO audit", "why is my organic traffic down" or an "SEO health check". Requires the Ryze MCP connector to be added first.

say_en.text: Run an SEO audit on my site.
say_en.note: Pulls your GSC and GA4 data into one report

say_en.text: Why is my organic traffic down?
say_en.note: Compares last 90 days with the previous 90
Covered under Quick wins in the report
